Name: Yandere Leah

Description:
[b]Please be careful when using other mods in addition to this mod that may slightly alter or add, or completely change, Leah's dialogues and events.

[/b]This mod changes Leah into a "Yandere". Included are her regular (with *slight* changes to some of her event dialogue depending on the choice of the player), her 1-year festivals, breakup & divorce + bouquet & pendant, and resort dialogues.
